scope.limitation: This is a repository/project-artifact reverse audit plus recovered conversation context, not a claim that every historical chat token or unavailable external attachment was re-read byte-for-byte.

turns.name: BACK_TO_ORIGIN
turns.question: What existed before any physical target claim?
turns.result: The root was an interpretive network reversal from Lave/LOVE and Edan/EDEM toward a pyramid receiver. It was explicitly marked semantic/project-level. No ancient device, beam or Eden identity was established.
turns.correction: Do not narrate Cousteau as if it began from a detected ocean anomaly. It began from an interpretive route that was progressively forced through physical gates.

turns.name: FORWARD_TO_FIRST_REAL_PHYSICS
turns.question: What was the first independently physical stress test?
turns.result: Real impact/melt sites, especially Kamil, supplied measured geology and partially reconstructed trajectories. Kamil failed both LOVE and EDEM endpoint direction tests.
turns.correction: Kamil is not corroboration. It is one of the project's strongest falsification controls.

turns.name: LEFT__GEOMETRY_FREEDOM_AUDIT
turns.question: Did any Kamil/pyramid geometry survive after removing steering freedom?
turns.result: No. The apparent EDEM accessibility at 44.5 degrees depended on free azimuth around 291 degrees. Frozen SOUTH shaft/face/apex operators all failed. Randomized sky nulls showed no specificity.
turns.dependency_warning: The free-azimuth and rigid-operator results are not two independent experiments; the rigid test supersedes the interpretation of the free-azimuth result.

turns.name: RIGHT__MATERIAL_INDEPENDENCE_AUDIT
turns.question: Could Kamil glass independently preserve an archaeological/material clue?
turns.result: Current published clean white-glass bulk data are almost pure silica, do not support a bulk pyramid-like matrix, and do not report Au/Ag or worked-metal morphology. The remaining microdomain question is genuinely open but unmeasured/unspecified in the public tables.

turns.name: FORWARD_AGAIN__MELT_SITE_GENERALIZATION
turns.question: Did another melt site rescue the route?
turns.result: No clean route match emerged. Dakhleh is scientifically valuable because it is an Egyptian high-temperature glass field with unresolved trajectory; Wabar offers only model-sensitive declination compatibility. Other scored controls failed or were underconstrained.
turns.rule: Do not score Dakhleh against LOVE/EDEM until trajectory is reconstructed independently.

turns.name: BACK_AGAIN__EARTH_LOCUS_DEGENERACY
turns.question: What part of the LOVE/EDEM Earth geometry is intrinsic?
turns.result: The internal bisector fixes latitude approximately -3.865418 degrees. Longitude is sidereal-time dependent. The 3.854924E ocean point is a frozen timestamp-specific legacy test, not a unique location demanded by the sky pair.
turns.major_correction: The journal must distinguish INTRINSIC_LATITUDE from LEGACY_TIMESTAMP_SPECIFIC_LONGITUDE.

turns.name: ASCEND__WHY_COUSTEAU
turns.question: Why build an ocean/acoustic branch at all?
turns.result: Because after Kamil and Giza failed as fixed physical alignments, the remaining falsifiable path was to ask whether any measured ocean target along a frozen search domain could be distinguished from natural geology/biology/propagation/processing. Cousteau was designed as the discriminator, not as an evidence generator by association.

turns.name: BACK__COUSTEAU_CALIBRATION_CHAIN
turns.question: Was Cousteau validated end-to-end before unknown-field interpretation?
turns.result: Not fully. Titanic provides excellent known-target geometry, sonar maps, CTD, metallurgy and 3D truth, but the direct complex resonance/transfer-function data needed for the strongest blind round-trip calibration were not recovered in the frozen benchmark pass.
turns.implication: Any unknown-field resonance/geometry inference must keep this missing calibration explicit.

turns.name: FORWARD__HISTORICAL_ACOUSTIC_REVERSE
turns.question: Do old mysterious sonar cases support a stationary submerged structure?
turns.result: No historical case was identified as such. A simple single stationary pyramid direct-echo model fails the reported moving-track kinematic sanity test in the Gallaudet account. Deep-scattering layers and bio-duck demonstrate strong natural lookalikes; Soviet quacker accounts remain ambiguous and data-poor.
turns.correction: Historical mystery longevity or apparent machine-like regularity is not independent target evidence.

turns.name: LEFT__FREQUENCY_SPECIFICITY
turns.question: Do 520-class or 119-Hz features give independent keys?
turns.result: No. The ~520.408-Hz model prior is explicitly non-blind and non-specific: natural iceberg harmonics can sit almost exactly at 520 Hz and biological bands overlap. The HA10 119-Hz branch sits deep in EDH response rolloff and the preregistered response-corrected confirmatory result is frozen negative.
turns.dependency_warning: 520-class modeling and 119-Hz HA10 testing are separate model branches, not two corroborating detections. Neither may be counted as a target-identification vote.

turns.name: RIGHT__TPHASE_AND_COSMOS_PSEUDOREPLICATION
turns.question: Did real T-phase events line up with the legacy point or celestial geometry?
turns.result: No. The legacy anchor was outside blind cluster envelopes; the nearest event remained hundreds of kilometres away after conservative error sanity checks; Mid-Atlantic-Ridge tectonic structure outperformed the legacy-anchor association. The best full date-location-cosmos crossmatch was non-significant after look-elsewhere (empirical p about 0.693).
turns.correction: A small geometric residual selected from thousands of events is not evidence without global look-elsewhere survival.

turns.name: ASCEND__FULL_LATITUDE_CIRCLE
turns.question: What changed when longitude degeneracy was respected?
turns.result: The correct intrinsic domain became the full latitude circle. A 360-degree scan placed the closest AF-SA/MAR boundary approach near 11.79W at ~0.52 km, but the project itself correctly classified this as an expected look-elsewhere geometry and prohibited retargeting.

important_split.11_79W: post-scan exploratory discriminating measurement longitude; not detected target

turns.name: BACK__TOBI_SELECTION_DEPENDENCY
turns.question: Is TOBI CD169 line19 an independent confirmation of the LOVE/EDEM locus?
turns.result: No. The CD169 survey is independent real data, but the selected crossing is defined by intersecting that independent track with the already-derived intrinsic latitude. Therefore the existence of a crossing is not independent celestial corroboration. Its value is that it may provide high-resolution sidescan/interferometric bathymetry/chirp/magnetics at a preregistered geographic slice.
turns.relation_to_MAR_exploratory_lon: The longitude differs from -11.79 by about 0.352 degrees (~39 km at this latitude); they are not the same point.
turns.natural_context: Local non-transform-discontinuity, volcanic and hydrothermal structures are mandatory controls.

turns.name: FORWARD__KAMIL_LIKE_RING_REUSE
turns.question: Why does Kamil reappear inside Cousteau?
turns.result: As a morphology falsification template. Circular/ring/bowl geometry in marine data is insufficient: an impact-like candidate must show coherent multi-channel geophysical diagnostics and outperform fault-basin, volcanic-collapse and hydrothermal models. The publication-level TOBI corridor scan found no confirmed Kamil-like impact candidate.

turns.name: LEFT__HA10_SELECTION_PATH
turns.question: Does HA10/H10N1 provide independent support for the original Kamil/LOVE/EDEM/Osiris chain?
turns.result: No. HA10 was elevated by the full system as a high-quality public acoustic calibration/measurement target. Its later BAS bathymetry and H10N1 blind morphology are legitimate physical results but the site-selection path is different from the original LOVE/EDEM locus and must not be back-propagated as confirmation of it.
turns.current_H10N1: 2km primary p~0.1905 rank4/21; 1km secondary p~0.0476 rank1/21; physical anomaly gate not advanced.

turns.name: RIGHT__SOUTHERN_SEAMOUNT
turns.question: Does Southern Seamount/wishbone change the claim?
turns.result: No. The seamount has a strong volcanic/MAR baseline. Published wishbone/crag descriptions remain ungeoreferenced. P2548 and modern survey lanes are valuable because they may recover real primary seafloor measurements, not because the descriptive morphology already implies an artificial object.

turns.name: FORWARD_AGAIN__JR15001_AND_P2548
turns.question: Where is the highest-value present-day information gain?
turns.result: Primary provenance. JR15001 em122.ACO could establish whether real EM122 swath coverage includes H10N1. P2548 could recover 2002 survey geometry/processing and Southern route/site products. TOBI bytes could resolve the intrinsic-latitude corridor with high-resolution multi-channel data. These are stronger than inventing new semantic links.

turns.name: BACK_AGAIN__INTERNAL_COUNCIL_INDEPENDENCE
turns.question: Can agreement among JANUS faces count as replication?
turns.result: No. The Full Assembly explicitly states MULTI_FACE_AGREEMENT_IS_NOT_EXTERNAL_CORROBORATION. HRain, iNaiHR, DemiHead, Aura, Cousteau, Fundamentum, AIFC and Cosmos share project inputs and are governance/analysis lanes, not independent experiments.

missed_or_underindexed_nodes.problem: Journal v1.0 began too late in the story and did not explain why Kamil mattered or that its rigid physical tests were negative.
Current open-gates snapshot omitted the Kamil white-glass Au/Ag microdomain branch.
Dakhleh is the strongest missed Egyptian melt-field control but is currently unscorable for direction; this was absent from the consolidated journal.

The journal described Cousteau controls but did not emphasize that the strongest end-to-end blind known-target calibration remains open because direct complex target-return/transfer-function data were not recovered.
The journal retained the frozen 3.854924E point but underemphasized the later correction that only latitude is intrinsic and the proper unconstrained domain is a full longitude circle.

TOBI line19 crossing can look like an independent location match, but its crossing coordinate is selected by the same intrinsic latitude. The data are independent; the location-selection criterion is not.
H10N1 morphology/watchlist could be narratively pulled backward into the Osiris/Kamil/LOVE/EDEM story even though HA10 was selected as a data-rich calibration target.
The old mysterious-sonar corpus was indexed, but the strongest reverse conclusion—simple single stationary pyramid fails the Gallaudet motion-class sanity check—was not prominent in journal v1.0.

520-class and 119-Hz branches could be remembered as multiple frequency clues. The controls show 520 is common/non-specific and 119 is response-edge-limited with a frozen negative confirmatory result.

The archive source manifest accurately described data/cousteau and data/love but did not explicitly index data/giza, workspace, data/stargate and linked meta-registry parents that are physically/conceptually part of the project lineage.

not_independent_evidence: multiple transforms of the same LOVE/EDEM coordinates
TOBI crossing selected by the same intrinsic latitude
MAR longitude selected after a full 360-degree scan
520 and 119 frequency branches treated as if two detections
HA10 calibration selection back-propagated into original target hypothesis

Kamil provides a strong real-world impact/melt negative control with independent direction constraints.
Blind TESS rediscovery of TOI 3494.01 is a positive-control success for the sky-search pipeline.
Public HA10 waveform and native BAS bathymetry provide real physical data, even though current anomaly claims fail or remain weak.
BODC confirmation of JR15001 em122.ACO/MBANSWCB provenance creates a clean next coverage test.
TOBI CD169, if identifier and bytes are verified, could provide genuinely high-resolution multi-channel geology at a preregistered latitude slice.
The project has repeatedly preserved negatives instead of moving coordinates or changing thresholds.
